::: {#thm-slr-additive}
#### Additive form of the simple linear regression model

In a simple linear regression model (@def-slr),
each outcome is its conditional mean plus a deviation (@def-slr-deviation);
given the covariates, the deviations are independent and Gaussian
with mean 0 and variance $\sigma^2$:

$$
Y_i = \mean_i + \cdev_i,
\qquad
\cdev_i \mid X_i = x_i \simind \ndist{0, \sigma^2}.
$$
:::

::: proof
@exr-slr-additive shows that $Y_i = \mean_i + \cdev_i$,
and @exr-slr-deviation-dist shows that
$\cdev_i \mid X_i = x_i \simind \ndist{0, \sigma^2}$.
:::
